# Unvibe — External AI Agent & Web Chatbot Drop-In Pack (UI/UX & Themes Only)

Use this folder when working outside Antigravity—in any external AI coding agent, IDE custom instruction box, or web chatbot. Every file here focuses **exclusively on UI/UX, visual design, layout, accessibility, and theming**.

## Quick Start

1. **One-File External Skill:** Upload or paste [UNVIBE-SKILL.md](./UNVIBE-SKILL.md) into your external agent or chatbot custom instructions.
2. **Pick One Theme Spec:** Attach or paste any single file from `design-md/<theme-id>.DESIGN.md` below (or copy it to your project root as `DESIGN.md`).
3. **Optional Prompt Wrappers:** Use [chatbot-system-prompt.md](../prompts/chatbot-system-prompt.md) for new UI or [redline-prompt.md](../prompts/redline-prompt.md) to clean up existing UI code.
